title: Relative & Reflexive Pronouns: Clause Linking & Self-Reference
subtitle: CEFR B1–B2 • Defining Clauses (Who, Which, That) & Reflexive Intensifiers

topics.title: 1. Relative Pronouns (Who, Which, That, Where)
topics.subtitle: Connecting Two Short Sentences into One Fluid Thought
topics.explanation: Kata ganti penghubung (who untuk orang, which untuk benda/ide, that untuk orang/benda dalam klausa penting, where untuk tempat) menggabungkan dua kalimat pendek menjadi satu kalimat kompleks yang mengalir tanpa pengulangan kata benda.
topics.rationale: Ciri utama pembicara tingkat B1–B2 adalah kemampuan menyisipkan informasi tambahan langsung di belakang kata benda tanpa memutus kalimat menjadi potongan pendek.

formulas.pattern: [Person + who / that + V]  |  [Thing + which / that + V]  |  [Place + where + S + V]
[Noun] + who / which / that + Aux + not + V
Is this the [Noun] + who / which / that + S + V?

conditionalExamples.positive: She is the engineer who built the parser that handles JSON validation.
conditionalExamples.negative: We shouldn't use libraries which don't have active maintenance.
conditionalExamples.question: Is this the coworking space where the hackathon took place?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Dalam klausa yang memuat informasi ekstra (diapit koma), gunakan 'which' atau 'who'—jangan gunakan 'that'.

specialExceptions.title: Jangan Mengulang Kata Ganti Objek di Dalam Relative Clause
specialExceptions.explanation: Kata 'which/that/who' sudah mewakili objeknya, jadi jangan tambahkan 'it/him/her' lagi di akhir klausa.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: The feature that we deployed it yesterday works smoothly.
specialExceptions.correctExample: The feature that we deployed yesterday works smoothly.

tipsAndTricks: Jika 'who/which/that' diikuti langsung oleh Subjek baru (the book [that] I read), kamu boleh menghilangkan 'that' agar kalimat terdengar lebih cepat dan natural.

topics.title: 2. Reflexive Pronouns (Myself, Yourself, Themselves)
topics.subtitle: Same Subject-Object & Autonomous Action Emphasis
topics.explanation: Digunakan ketika pelaku dan penerima aksi adalah orang yang sama (I taught myself), atau untuk menegaskan bahwa seseorang melakukan sesuatu secara mandiri tanpa bantuan (by myself).
topics.rationale: Membedakan makna 'dia melukai orang lain' (he hurt him) dengan 'dia melukai dirinya sendiri' (he hurt himself).

formulas.pattern: Subject + Verb + [myself / yourself / himself / herself / itself / ourselves / themselves]

conditionalExamples.positive: I taught myself TypeScript by building real projects.
conditionalExamples.negative: The system doesn't restart itself after a kernel panic.
conditionalExamples.question: Did you configure the deployment pipeline by yourself?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: 'By myself' berarti sendirian atau secara mandiri tanpa bantuan orang lain.

specialExceptions.title: Bentuk Jamak Berakhiran -selves (Bukan -selfs)
specialExceptions.explanation: Untuk kata ganti jamak (we, you plural, they), akhiran berubah menjadi -selves: ourselves, yourselves, themselves.

tipsAndTricks: Hindari memakai 'myself' sebagai pengganti 'me' di email formal (jangan tulis 'Please contact John or myself'—cukup 'Please contact John or me').

scenario.interlocutor: Reviewer teknis menanyakan fungsi salah satu modul backend
scenario.intent: Menjelaskan fungsi modul dalam satu kalimat terhubung tanpa redundansi kata ganti.

options.text: This is the service which it authenticates user tokens.
This is the service which authenticates user tokens.
This is the service who authenticates user tokens.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: 'Which' sudah menggantikan subjek 'the service', sehingga langsung diikuti kata kerja 'authenticates'.
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: Opsi A mengulang subjek dengan 'it', sedangkan Opsi C memakai 'who' yang hanya berlaku untuk manusia.
deepExplanation.realLifeHack: Gunakan 'who' untuk manusia, 'which' untuk sistem/benda, dan 'that' sebagai jembatan serbaguna.
